_about: Measured missions: what real runs of this product cost in model usage. Hand-maintained evidence, not generated; scripts/export-pricing.mjs re-prices each run's tokens at the published list prices and writes the result into plans.json for the pricing page and calculator. A run is added here only with its source. One run is an illustration, not a rate.

runs.mission: A dependency-free Node library and CLI for 5-field cron expressions, built from a written spec by five seats, then reopened once against an independent oracle's defect report, with a kill -9 of the host in the middle of the second round.
runs.outcome: Goal met twice (round 1 in 9 min 53 s; again 18 min 33 s after the reopen). The final product scored 99.6% of 3034 stratified checks on an oracle written from the spec before any output was read; its own suite passed 63 of 63.
